Seen • Just now
Yes. We offer a Low Price Guarantee with two options:
Price drop after purchase: If the item you bought goes on clearance or is marked down within 30 days of the order date, you can request a price adjustment for the difference. 
Competitor price match: If you find the identical item at a lower advertised price from a retailer with a physical store, the price can be matched and an additional 10% off may apply. Proof of the lower price is required. 
The item must be the same brand, model, size, color, and specifications, and currently in stock at both retailers.

• Just now
Seen • Just now
Most of our furniture includes a 1‑year limited warranty from the date of delivery for manufacturer defects in workmanship and materials.
Frames and springs on seating items (sofas, recliners, sectionals, etc.) are covered for 3 years for structural defects.
The warranty applies to the original purchaser only and is not transferable.
If a defect is found, the item may be repaired or have the defective part replaced. Delivery costs are not covered if the entire item is replaced.
To start a warranty claim, you can submit details and photos of the issue here:
https://www.livingspaces.com/help/warranty
Examples of covered issues include structural problems, defective upholstery, or manufacturing defects reported within the warranty period.
